limits: Previously inspected fixture photos, not a new independent holdout.
Nine selected painting queries cover only two identities; the broader positive2 corpus is building dominated.

The cached upload experiment had an 11.564-second first cold request; mobile/network latency is not measured.
Initial seventeen failed HTTP 503 attempts are retained separately from the later successful run.
